title.zh: 地震波探地心 · 地核是被波“照”出来的
title.en: Seismic Waves · The Core Was “Lit Up” by Waves

desc.zh: 地震发出的 P 波和 S 波一前一后到达；它们在地球里拐弯、被挡住的方式，让人从没去过的地核有了名字、大小和状态。
desc.en: An earthquake sends out P and S waves that arrive one after the other; how they bend and get blocked inside the Earth gave the core — which nobody has visited — a size, a name and a state.
